prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE standalone structure sprite for the asteroid-belt view of Stellar Syndicates, a space strategy game: an Asteroid Quarry, a self-contained zero-gravity mine that clamps onto an asteroid and carries its own crew quarters and power. Square transparent PNG, 1254 x 1254.
Purpose: the game places this sprite on top of a large rock in a separately painted asteroid field. Draw the quarry ONLY: no asteroid, rock, rubble, dust, cut terraces, pit, crater, terrain, base plate, stars, planet or background. Genuine zero-alpha transparency around the structure; keep a translucent soft contact shadow under its feet.
Input images: Image 1 is the approved design for tier 1: one articulated arm whose bell-shaped sealed cutter head works the rock, a ribbed flexible hose carrying the cuttings to a low module that holds the processing plant and crew quarters, an upright solar panel on its roof, and a long docking boom. Keep its design, proportions and cream-white finish at every tier, but draw no rock and no ship at the boom. Image 2 is the game's approved orbital fusion plant: match its rendering, materials, lighting and finish, not its ring or layout. Image 3, when attached, is this quarry's tier just below: keep everything in it and grow from it. Image 4, attached for tier 6 only, is the reference for the full-grown mine: take its machinery, not its asteroid, ships, drones, people or photographic look.
Zero gravity: everything is held by structure. The quarry rests on short anchor feet clamped at the foot line, its cutter heads are sealed against the rock, and ore moves only through hoses, pipes and sealed containers. No ore heaps, chutes, open conveyors, smoke stacks, sparks, beams, glow haze or flying debris.
Style: near-future frontier engineering. Soft semi-realistic 3D game rendering; cream-white and pale grey modules and arms with amber-yellow trim, graphite steel trusses and hoses, dark blue-grey solar panels, pale radiator panels, restrained warm amber window and work lights, a few cyan docking lights. Large readable forms that still read at 100 px, realistic restrained detail; no ink outlines, cel shading, plastic gloss, extreme contrast or neon. No text, logos, numerals, UI, people, vehicles or spacecraft.
Camera and lighting: elevated front-left three-quarter view, about 40 degrees above the surface the quarry stands on; mild perspective; front and right sides visible. Upper-left sunlight with crisp, soft-edged shadows and a cool neutral fill; the contact shadow falls to the lower right.
Framing/alignment (match the game's other buildings): solid structure width about 94% of the canvas (x about 3-97%), centred at x=50%: the arms on the left, the modules in the middle, the docking boom reaching the right edge. The anchor feet and cutter heads, the lowest solid points, at y about 88%. At least 3% transparent margin above the tallest point. Same footprint and overall width at every tier: new parts grow upward and fill in, so nothing shrinks. Never crop.
Output exactly one structure, no tier lineup/contact sheet.
Subject: ASTEROID QUARRY, the structure only - TIER 6 of 6.
This tier specifically: keep all of tier 5; grow into the full mine of Image 4 on the same compact site: a monumental two-level processing block with three tall silos, a fourth arm, a second habitat cylinder, larger solar arrays and the docking boom full of ore containers; dense and tall, not a sprawling base.
Tier family progression for context (do NOT draw a lineup): 1: one arm, one module with crew quarters, one solar panel and a docking boom; 2: a second arm, a second solar panel and an ore tank; 3: a crew habitat cylinder, a four-panel solar array and two radiator fins; 4: a raised processing deck, a third arm and ore containers along the boom; 5: tall ore silos, a radiator bank, a beacon mast and more anchor feet; 6: the full-grown mine of Image 4: a monumental processing block, three tall silos and four arms, on the same compact site.
Output: exactly the requested tier alone, genuine transparent PNG.
This is the FINAL and largest quarry tier. Image 3 is the immediately previous tier and controls the exact machinery family, camera, materials and compact footprint. Image 4 is an inspiration for the amount and type of industrial machinery ONLY: do not copy its asteroid, ships, dark photographic rendering, broad sprawl, or open mining terraces. The approved game style of Images 2 and 3 takes priority.
Keep all major tier-5 features and enlarge the raised processing structure into a substantial TWO-LEVEL block with open supporting trusses and pale industrial cladding; this should read as the heavy completed version of the same outpost. Add ONE extra silo, so there are exactly THREE tall vertical ore silos with amber bands. Add ONE new articulated arm with a sealed bell-shaped capture hood and ribbed enclosed ore hose at the rear left, so FOUR distinct mining arms and FOUR capture hoods are clearly visible total, stepping diagonally down the left side. Add ONE second horizontal crew habitat cylinder with warm windows, so TWO habitat cylinders are visible. Enlarge the dark solar array while retaining the pale radiator bank and original fins. Retain the beacon mast. Fill the existing docking boom with closed ore containers and keep its cyan-lit end berth empty. Every arm has an enclosed material path to the processing block.
Pack upgrades into the existing upper-left headroom and above the central modules, not outward beyond the site. Keep the original arms and module sizes, approx94% total image width, and enough clear transparent margin around every edge. The lowest anchor foot or cutter should be near88% canvas height, with the highest part no higher than y=40. Do not crop any machinery. Preserve distinct large silhouettes despite the density. No asteroid, rock, rubble, ground layer, baseplate, dust, sparks, beams, ships, drones, people, labels, logos or text. Exactly ONE finished tier-6 building sprite on a square 1254x1254 transparent canvas.

refinements.prompt:
Precise additive edit of this transparent 1254x1254 game sprite.
Keep the supplied image unchanged except for ONE addition: add a second horizontal crew habitat cylinder in the currently empty upper-left area, above the rearmost mining arm and to the left of the three silos. Make it a clearly readable cream cylinder with graphite end rings, amber trim, and a row of four warm amber rectangular windows along its side, matching the existing horizontal habitat under the central deck. It should occupy roughly x=280..570 and y=100..250, so it fits fully inside the existing outer footprint and clear margins. Support this new cylinder on short graphite trusses integrated into the existing rear upper processing structure, and connect it to the processing block with one short enclosed pressurized tube. This is an attached crew module, not a spacecraft or a floating separate object.
The final sprite should clearly contain TWO crew habitat cylinders, FOUR mining arms with sealed hoods and enclosed hoses, THREE tall ore silos, the existing processing levels, solar panels, radiator bank, beacon mast, and full cargo docking boom. Preserve all existing machinery positions, scale, shapes, colors, perspective, lighting, crop and canvas size. Do not remove any parts or change the lower layout. No rock, terrain, ground, baseplate, people, vehicles, ships, text or labels. Retain genuine alpha transparency and existing soft contact shadows. Only add this one second habitat cylinder and its short supporting connection.
